newsitem.title: CHINA: China petrochemical plant blast kills four.
newsitem.headline: China petrochemical plant blast kills four.

text.p: Four people were killed and more than 50 injured in an explosion at a petrochemical plant in northeast China last month, plant officials said on Friday.
The explosion occurred at the Fushun Ethylene Petrochemical Company, part of a petrochemical complex, in Fushun city, Liaoning province, on May 16.
"There was an explosion involving production equipment at the plant," said a plant official by telephone.
Three seriously injured workers were still in hospital.
He said the cause of the blast was still under investigation.
The plant produces 115,000 tonnes of ethylene a year.
Production had resumed after a brief disruption but output would be reduced this year, the official said. He gave no further details.
